name: CreateSecurityGroup

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the security group. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 安全组所属地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html查看最新的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The description of the security group. The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length. It cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.

Default value: empty
parameters.help_zh:
安全组描述信息。长度为2~256个英文或中文字符，不能以`http://`和`https://`开头。

默认值：空
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The ClientToken value can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多详情，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The name of the security group. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length and must start with a letter or a Chinese character. It cannot start with `http://` or `https://`. The name can contain characters that are categorized as letters in Unicode, including letters in English and Chinese, and digits. The name can also contain colons (:), underscores (_), periods (.), or hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh: 安全组名称。长度为2~128个字符，必须以大小写字母或中文开头，不能以`http://`和`https://`开头。支持Unicode中letter分类下的字符（其中包括英文、中文等）和数字。可以包含半角冒号（:）、下划线（_）、半角句号（.）或者短划线（-）
parameters.name: security_group_name

parameters.help_en: The ID of the VPC to which the security group belongs
parameters.name: vpc_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the security group. Valid values:

normal: basic security group.
enterprise: advanced security group. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/120621.html.

Default value: normal
parameters.help_zh:
安全组类型，分为普通安全组与企业安全组。取值范围：

normal：普通安全组。
enterprise：企业安全组。更多详情，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/120621.html。

默认值：normal
parameters.name: security_group_type

parameters.help_en: This parameter is not publicly available
parameters.name: service_managed

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group to which the security group belongs
parameters.help_zh: 安全组所在的企业资源组ID
parameters.name: resource_group_id

fields.help_en:
The tag key of the security group.

The tag key cannot be an empty string. The tag key can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh:
安全组的标签键。

一旦传入该值，则不允许为空字符串。最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The tag value of the security group.

The tag value can be an empty string. The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh:
安全组的标签值。

一旦传入该值，允许为空字符串。最多支持128个字符，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
fields.name: value

fields.help_en:
The tag key of the security group.

To improve compatibility, use the Tag.N.Key parameter
fields.help_zh:
安全组的标签键。

为提高兼容性，建议您尽量使用Tag.N.Key参数
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The tag value of the security group.

To improve compatibility, use the Tag.N.Value parameter
fields.help_zh:
安全组的标签值。

为提高兼容性，建议您尽量使用Tag.N.Value参数
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: The tags to add to the security group. Array length: 0 to 20
parameters.help_zh: 安全组绑定的标签数组。数组长度：0~20
parameters.name: tag
